This method returns true under the following conditions: - The shooter can see the entity ( Player.canSee(Entity) ) - The entity is alive and not a spectator - The projectile has left the hitbox of the shooter ( hasLeftShooter() ) - If this is an arrow with piercing, it has not pierced the entity already Parameters: entity - the entity to check if this projectile can hit Returns: true if this projectile can damage the entity, false otherwise hitEntity void   hitEntity ( @NotNull @NotNull Entity  entity) Makes this projectile hit a specific entity.
